svg.text: Allocation map, not to scale. Match long-strip housings to the tested 2×3 pieces before cutting.
Four removable pieces; all 64 module pins remain populated.
This drawing does not establish socket contact depth or stack height.
Numbers below are contact columns along the strip. Each column contains two sockets.
Reserve columns 11, 22, 29 and 36 for cuts; the second long strip stays intact.
Red X columns are discarded to leave room for cutting without using a kept contact as the cut line.
Housing length, cutting method and contact engagement must be checked before making the cuts.
2026-11-06 • Assembly planning aid; PCB hole positions are unchanged.
